title: ROHL C2503APC 7" Wall Mount Tub Spout, Polished Chrome
writeup: ROHL's C2503APC is an Italian-made brass wall-mount tub spout with a 7-inch reach and a 3/4-inch female NPT inlet, finished in polished chrome. Specialty dealers like GN Kitchen and Bath and Cornerstone sell it for $191, so Woot's $95.99 cuts the price roughly in half.
